meta.siteDescription: Warm editorial multi-domain subdomain directory, instant DNS studio, and live health monitor.

admin.envMissingDesc: Add ADMIN_PASSWORD with NAMECOM_USERNAME / NAMECOM_TOKEN in Vercel Environment Variables (or .env.local) to enable 1-click live DNS writes.
admin.signInDesc: Authenticate once to create or delete live DNS records on Name.com or Cloudflare without opening a manual PR.

domains.noteNamecom: Primary dev domain managed via Name.com Core API
domains.noteNamecheap: Namecheap BasicDNS — copy helper & live DoH verification, or switch NS to Cloudflare

overview.heroTitle: Route every side project in seconds.
overview.heroSubtitle: Pick a root domain, preview exact CNAME, A, or TXT rows with zero guesswork, verify live DoH propagation, or publish straight to Name.com in one click.
overview.cardLookupDesc: Filter across root domains, inspect live Name.com entries, run DoH checks, and copy targets.
overview.cardStudioDesc: Switch root domains with a fixed-width .domain suffix, copy rows, or publish via API.
overview.cardMonitorDesc: {live} live · {warn} warn · {dead} dead · Vercel env & provider diagnostics.
overview.emptyRegistryText: No Git-tracked subdomains yet. Create a live DNS record in Claim Subdomain or connect Name.com env vars to inspect live entries.

directory.title: Multi-Domain Directory
directory.subtitle: Inspect tracked subdomains and live registrar DNS entries, verify DoH resolution, and copy record values.
directory.noMatchDesc: Try another keyword or reset the domain and status filters.
directory.emptyDesc: Create your first subdomain in Claim Subdomain, or configure Vercel API env vars to list live Name.com records below.
directory.noGitFilesLiveBelow: No Git-tracked JSON files yet — live API records appear above.
directory.liveDescUnlocked: Admin unlocked: displaying all live API records (protected apex and mail entries cannot be deleted here).
directory.liveDescLocked: Public preview displays non-reserved A, AAAA, and CNAME records (60s cache). Unlock Admin for full access and delete actions.
directory.emptyLiveRecords: No live API DNS records returned for this selection. Add NAMECOM_USERNAME and NAMECOM_TOKEN in Vercel Environment Variables to connect your live zone.
directory.deleteDialogBody: This will immediately delete live record {type} {fqdn} → {value} from {domain}.
directory.deleteReservedConfirm: This is a reserved system label. Confirm permanent deletion.
directory.liveLoadError: Unable to load live DNS records.

claim.title: Instant Subdomain Studio
claim.subtitle: Choose an available root domain, configure your destination preset, and apply DNS directly or copy exact records.
claim.subdomainHint: Lowercase letters, numbers, hyphens, or dots (nested labels).
claim.reservedCheckboxText: Confirm applying reserved system label "{label}" on {domain}.
claim.presetVercelHint: In Vercel Project Settings → Domains, add your full subdomain first.
claim.presetGithubHint: Set custom domain in GitHub Repository → Settings → Pages.
claim.presetNetlifyHint: Add the custom domain in Netlify Site Configuration → Domain Management.
claim.presetVpsHint: Point directly to your server public IPv4 address.
claim.namecheapFooterText: Copy rows from panel 2 → paste into Domain List → Manage → Advanced DNS, then click Verify Live DNS.
claim.autoApiUnlockedDesc: Admin unlocked — click below to write DNS directly without a PR.
claim.autoApiLockedDesc: Unlock Admin once to write live DNS records in one click.
claim.autoApiEnvMissingDesc: Add ADMIN_PASSWORD & registrar tokens on Vercel to enable 1-click writes.
claim.dohHint: Query Cloudflare & Google DoH resolvers to confirm propagation.
claim.dohNetworkError: Unable to reach DoH lookup endpoint.
claim.errLabelEmpty: Enter a subdomain label (e.g. blog, api, docs).
claim.errLabelInvalid: Use lowercase letters, numbers, hyphens, or dots (no leading/trailing hyphen).
claim.errHardLockApex: Root apex (@) records are hard-locked to protect domain routing.
claim.errHardLockType: {type} records are managed directly at the DNS provider.
claim.errTargetCname: Enter a valid hostname without http:// or paths (e.g. cname.vercel-dns.com).
claim.errReservedConfirm: Check the confirmation box before applying reserved label "{label}".

health.title: Health, Quota & API Readiness
health.subtitle: Monitor registry probes, DNS quota thresholds, and Vercel server API configuration across your root domains.
health.serverEnvDesc: Boolean readiness checks only — API tokens stay strictly server-side in Vercel Environment Variables.
health.envAdminDesc: Required to unlock live DNS create/delete actions
health.envNamecomDesc: Direct create, list, and delete for Name.com zones
health.envCloudflareDesc: Optional live API sync for Cloudflare zones
health.emptyProbeText: No Git-tracked JSON files in domains/ yet — provider readiness above reflects your live API configuration.
